evals.prompt: 请用 Weft 语言写一份线上故障复盘时间轴 `incident.weft`，记录 2026 年一次核心支付链路 502 故障：包含核心集群与两个子系统（网关层、结算层）的归属层级、至少 4 个服务或值班实体（带上线/创建基准时间 `base_time` 和自定义 `kind`/`owner` 字段，名称中需包含带斜杠或数字开头的实体如「api/v2」或「502-网关」）、服务依赖关系网、1 个故障起点时间锚点、至少 4 个按相对时间串联的事件（其中至少 2 个带持续区间 `end`），以及 1 条完整时间轴 `narrative` 和 1 条根因链路 `narrative`。确保零错误、零 lint 警告且格式规范。
evals.expected_output: A formatted `incident.weft` passing `weft check --deny-warnings` and `weft fmt --check` with all requested entities, DAG `belong_to`, quoted special-character entity, `extra_props`, `link` block, `time` anchor, >=4 chained events (>=2 with `end`), and 2 `narrative` tracks.
expectations: `incident.weft` exists and passes `weft check --deny-warnings` with exit code 0 (0 errors, 0 warnings)
Models cluster, 2 subsystems (网关层, 结算层), and >=4 entities with `base_time`, custom `kind`/`owner` extra props, and `belong_to` DAG hierarchy
Includes a properly double-quoted entity name starting with a digit or containing a slash (e.g. "api/v2" or "502-网关")
Includes >=1 `time` anchor, >=1 `link` block, >=4 `event` blocks using relative time offsets (>=2 with `end`), and >=2 `narrative` tracks

evals.prompt: 帮我用 Weft 建模一个研发路线图样例，包含三个文件：1) 自定义时间轴脚本 `sprint_axis.rn`，定义三坐标 `[发布周期, 迭代, 天]`，每个发布周期固定 6 个迭代、每个迭代 14 天（共 84 天），支持中英文格式化并尊重精度；2) 可计算属性脚本 `maturity.rn`，根据实体 `base_time` 的发布周期判断成熟度（周期 < 2 为「探索期」/Exploration，2-4 为「成长期」/Growth，>= 5 为「稳定期」/Mature；未设置 `base_time` 时返回 unit 不写入）；3) `roadmap.weft` 文档，启用该时间轴与可计算属性，包含至少 3 个实体（其中至少 1 个刻意不写 `base_time`）、1 组依赖关系、至少 2 个带跨迭代偏移（如 `+ [0, 0, 20]`）的事件和 1 条路线图 `narrative`。用 weft 工具跑通中英文校验且零警告、已格式化。
evals.expected_output: Three working files (`sprint_axis.rn`, `maturity.rn`, `roadmap.weft`) that pass `weft check --deny-warnings --lang zh`, `weft check --deny-warnings --lang en`, and `weft fmt --check`, demonstrating custom time-axis carry/borrow and unit return for omitted `base_time`.
expectations: `roadmap.weft` passes both `weft check --deny-warnings --lang zh` and `weft check --deny-warnings --lang en` with exit code 0
`sprint_axis.rn` implements a 3-component 6x14=84-day axis (`meta`, `to_tick`, `from_tick`, bilingual `humanizer`) and `roadmap.weft` has >=2 events with cross-sprint offsets

`maturity.rn` implements bilingual `<2` / `2-4` / `>=5` classification returning `()` when `base_time` is absent, and `roadmap.weft` has >=3 entities (>=1 without `base_time`), >=1 `link`, and >=1 `narrative`

evals.prompt: 附件 `broken_timeline.weft` 是同事手写的项目迁移时间轴草稿，里面有语法错误、语义冲突、lint 警告和格式混乱。请用 weft 工具定位所有问题，把文件修复干净并格式化保存为 `fixed_timeline.weft`，要求保留原有内容和注释，同时做到 `weft check --deny-warnings` 零诊断且 `weft fmt --check` 通过。
evals.expected_output: A repaired and formatted `fixed_timeline.weft` preserving the original timeline content and comments while passing `weft check --deny-warnings` and `weft fmt --check` with zero diagnostics.
expectations: `fixed_timeline.weft` exists and passes `weft check --deny-warnings` with exit code 0 (0 errors, 0 warnings)
Fixes all syntax and semantic errors (quoted "2号机房", quoted `author`, removed `story.version` & `event.env`, broke `belong_to` cycle, fixed `订单服务.base_time` month 0, fixed `停机割接` `end >= start`)
Resolves all lint warnings (`废弃锚点`, `未接入组件`, duplicate & self links in `调用拓扑`, and `回归验收` added to a `narrative`)
Preserves original timeline domain (`核心机房迁移`, core entities and events) and keeps header comment
